messages:
ivy: Minor WFH flex: I mounted my router in a waterproof plant pot on the balcony and actually got full bars in the study. surprisingly stable! :seedling: :wifi:

nick: balcony router! bold move. any weatherproofing tips?

ivy: lined the pot with a zip-top bag + silicon sealant around the base, kept it raised on bricks so drainage still works. unplug during storms tho.

tess: did you need an extension cord or ethernet run? curious about latency for video calls.

ivy: short outdoor-rated Ethernet run, taped along the railing. latency was solid (tested with `ping 1.1.1.1 -c 5`).

omar: vote: innovative or wildly irresponsible? react with :tada: for innovative, :umbrella: for irresponsible.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Noted increased tethering and outdoor setups in community reports 2027-04-04T08:30:00Z. No ISP outage detected. Reminder: secure outdoor cabling and avoid water ingress.

nick: also, pro tip: label outdoor cables with bright tape so you don't snag them while gardening. true story.

tess: can you post a pic? curious what the setup looks like. :camera_with_flash:

ivy: posted pics in thread (http://imgur.com/placeholder_balcony). will add short how-to to #devex: "Safe outdoor router perch" with warnings about weather and power safety.

omar: kudos for creativity and for adding safety notes. also please don't put routers in plant soil. :pray:
